THE_ARCHITECT.talk.INDIGOTAILOR-INDIGO_T: The entire Spire bears crushing weight. Pluck a few load-bearing seams, and stones unravel like rotten linen.
Insolent tailor. You equate my megastructure to loose threads on a beggar's coat?
The grander the edifice, the more seams it conceals. I can unpick it—or patch it anew.
Intriguing. Let us see if your Master Pattern can bridge the crumbling voids below.
The Spire's joins have loosened since last we spoke. I hear masonry grinding against masonry.
So long as the grand framework endures, rubble is merely selvedge awaiting a trim.
Leave the raw edge untended, and the whole bolt unspools along the warp.
Take up your great shears then, and excise the superfluous scraps.
NEOW.talk.INDIGOTAILOR-INDIGO_TAILOR_CHA: ...Solitary artisan of the Underdocks... your knuckles remain stained with indigo and scarred by needles...
The vat-dye never washes out, nor do the calluses. I climb to tie the final knot atop the Spire.
...The Spire's tapestry is soaked in rotten decay... Only fierce cuts may permit a new weaving... Take this blessing...
With my swift shears, I shall sever the foul drapery.
...Hark... The sharp snap of cold iron shears echoes once more within the gallery...
With each cut, an old debt is severed.
...May the deep cyan thread guide your needle...
DARV.talk.INDIGOTAILOR-INDIGO_TAILOR_CHA: Look what I fished from the carrion heaps! A stout thimble forged in virgin gold, textured with non-slip indentations!
Those aren't grips—they are calibration notches from an ancient loom to regulate warp tension.
Gear, trinket, who cares! Only a connoisseur can make it sing. A handful of copper or a sharp snip in trade, and it's yours!
Keep the coins; I take the thimble. With this, even coarse hemp thread will never snap.
Hey, seamstress! Got enough scraps and lacquer today? I just scavenged a crate of snapped shear-shanks!
Show me the temper. So long as the bevel is intact, Kintsugi gold can mend it true.
Bwahaha! I adore an artisan who treats rubbish like treasure! Pick your prize!
This sheared blade will make a formidable seam ripper.
OROBAS.talk.INDIGOTAILOR-INDIGO_TAILOR_C: The tides pulse through the weave. Mortal needles merely stitch flesh, but abyssal warp and weft reshape destiny.
I know cloth soaked in Underdocks tide-water; the colder the brine, the tighter the surge-twill sets.
Plunge your rusted iron thimble into the deep abyss... I shall bind the luminescent gold of ancient gods to your fingertips forever.
The thimble gleams with a golden aura. The whole loom hums in harmony.
The threads wound about your fingers drink deeper of the dark. Ready for another tempering?
Proceed. Let the indigo mordant fix permanently beneath oceanic frost.
Go forth, and show this hollow Spire what seamless weaving truly means.
PAEL.talk.INDIGOTAILOR-INDIGO_TAILOR_CHA: Every puncture weeps... yet through piercing and rending, new flesh and binding thread intertwine.
A tailor never fears needle-pricks. Only when rotten stitches are ripped free can the wound knit clean.
Endure the piercing pang... Grind down my ascetic bones into bodkins, and pierce armor thought invulnerable.
The bone needle is slender and chillingly sharp.
Your tears multiply, yet each reconstructed seam holds firmer than virgin cloth.
That is the virtue of patchwork. The more patches, the sturdier against tearing.
Suffering is warp; patience is weft. Take my bone, and stitch your path onward.
NONUPEIPE.talk.INDIGOTAILOR-INDIGO_TAILO: Oh! What exquisite, flawless snips! The way you plucked the gorget seams from that stone golem was sheer artistry!
Simple craft. However thick the plating, joints must allow room for movement.
Not just clean—even the falling offcuts carry the cold glamour of vat-dyed indigo! I adore fine craft. Select an adornment!
This crimson velvet pincushion is just what the atelier lacked.
Back again, my elegant cutter! Have you tailored shrouds for those clumsy Spire beasts today?
Their measurements are taken. I strip their excess plating away layer by layer.
Splendid! Keep snipping their grotesque pretensions into ribbons!
TANX.talk.INDIGOTAILOR-INDIGO_TAILOR_CHA: HAH! Woman, you haul an iron shear as tall as a man, yet your step is silent as a prowling cat!
Shears are not bludgeons. Follow the grain and push gently—even boiled leather parts on its own.
Vicious! I respect it! True slaughter isn't about bellowing—it's about slicing the vital seam in silence! Take this arming piece!
Much obliged. Its counterbalance will weight the selvedge nicely.
Glorious! I heard those shears snap clean through rib bones half a floor away!
Stubborn threads require a decisive cut.
Then snip them all! Dice every wretch in your path into offcuts!
TEZCATARA.talk.INDIGOTAILOR-INDIGO_TAILO: The glass divides existence. Snip a curve upon the left, and the reflection splits along a mirrored wound.
Weaving is symmetry in essence. Left lapel and right lapel must meet true, or the garment sits crooked.
Fold your hand... Along the mirrored crease, every lack becomes whole.
Mirror-light glazes the cloth; creases set into firm snaps.
You pause before the glass, tailor. The reflection combs out your tangled weft.
When the weave bunches, aligning both selvedges before the mirror sets them straight.
Gaze upon the true double, and fold hollow foes into oblivion.
VAKUU.talk.INDIGOTAILOR-INDIGO_TAILOR_CH: Within the Void lies an eternal tangle... Here, all threads lose origin and destination alike.
Give me a shuttle, and the gnarliest knot yields a leading strand.
Stubborn weaver... You dare weave order from the abyss. Welcome the void's chaos into your flying shuttle.
The tangle parts, resolving into a sliver of cool cyan sheen.
Whispers of nothingness wind about your wrist... Can you still tell the true thread from phantom filaments?
When my fingers brush it, whichever thread bears weight is real.
Follow that weight then... and let not the void pull you down.
My shears are heavy enough to keep me anchored.
